findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers immediately via a present assignment rather than waiting until you are paid in full, meaning the client could own your work without paying.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Deliverables shall remain with the Contractor until all Fees due under this Agreement have been paid in full, at which time ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are doing well. I am reviewing the paperwork and have one small suggestion before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership transfers immediately rather than waiting until payment is complete, so I propose we update it so that ownership of the deliverables shall remain with the contractor until all fees due under this agreement have been paid in full, at which time ownership shall transfer to the client. Thanks for your time, and I look forward to getting started.
